context_requirements: Expression of the relevant interleukin receptor complex on the cell surface
A transcriptional output program that is not already saturated by endogenous cytokines in the culture medium
falsifiers: Reproducible induction of canonical IL receptor/JAK-STAT target genes such as SOCS1, SOCS3, STAT1, STAT3, or interferon-stimulated genes at 6 h in any of the nine lines
Dose-dependent transcriptional changes at 10 micromolar that are absent at lower concentrations and not explained by nonspecific stress
Consistent changes across multiple lines that match a known interleukin response signature
